feeds.title: What Book Next
feeds.description: For your next great read, or picture book you need. I have read every book that has been reviewed on What Book Next.com. As a bookseller, I know how a cover can look like one thing to a young reader, but have content that is too scary, inappropriate, or off-putting for that reader.

feeds.title: SLANZA
feeds.description: Our membership is made up of school and public library staff, National Library staff, teachers, principals, publishers, book-sellers, and library-related solution providers. Further information about our membership options can be found here.

feeds.title: Kids Books NZ Blog
feeds.description: Kids Book NZ Blog reviews books because they are passionate about promoting New Zealand children's books. They promote children's books written by New Zealand authors. They will do their best to cover as many titles as possible even if this takes them a while. They appreciate your understanding in this matter. Go through their blog to learn more about their work.

feeds.title: NZ Booklovers
feeds.description: At NZ Booklovers we are passionate about books and believe they inspire and enhance people's lives. Find out about the best books as they publish! Check here for reviews, author interviews, articles and competitions. With book competitions, reviews, interviews, news & articles, & a shop, NZ Booklovers is a site for New Zealand bibliophiles & readers.

feeds.title: Bobs Books Blog
feeds.description: Children's and Young Adult Book Reviews by Bob Docherty. Discover interviews with inspiring people, hints and tips from renowned photographers, travelers and other experts. Stories from around the world written by us

feeds.title: SpecFic NZ
feeds.description: SpecFicNZ is the association for creators, writers and editors of fantasy, science fiction and horror in or from New Zealand. The organisation was founded in March 2009 to build a community focused on the promotion and proliferation of all aspects of the speculative fiction genre in this country.

feeds.title: Publishers Association Of New Zealand
feeds.description: New Zealand Books: the central hub where you will find fiction, nonfiction and children's literature available for international rights sales from publishers across Aotearoa New Zealand. Stay up to date with the latest New Zealand Books news and sign up for our mailing list.

feeds.title: Landfall Review
feeds.description: The Landfall Review extends out of the magazine to become Landfall Review Online. As well as the reviews included in the two print issues each year, Landfall publishes additional review pages online, each month featuring six to eight reviews. An archive of all previous online reviews is a feature of the site.

feeds.title: New Zealand Society of Authors
feeds.description: The New Zealand Society of Authors Te Puni Kaituhi o Aotearoa (PEN NZ Inc.) is a membership based arts organization, representing 1,600 writers nationally through our five regions and eight branches and many hubs. The aim is to actively and responsibly support and represent the interests of all New Zealand's writers and the communities they serve.

feeds.title: The Free-Range Bookclub
feeds.description: We read a wide scope of work, including newly published novels from a variety of countries and cultures, re-reads of classics we already adore, occasional poetry and non-fiction, as well enlightening discoveries of titles previously unknown to us. We read and review what's hot and what's not.

feeds.title: The Fantasy Inn
feeds.description: Fantasy book reviews, recs, raves and rants. We are seven fantasy fans from five different countries; our love for speculative fiction and the common need to share our favourite works led to the creation of this blog. You'll learn more about each of us in our individual bios!

feeds.title: Book Box NZ Blog
feeds.description: Keep up to date with book reviews of popular books, book related articles, and the latest book news and trends all in our Book Lovers blog - written by readers for readers! Explore the latest news, trends, and book reviews from Book Box NZ, New Zealand's original monthly book subscription service for adults, young adults and children.

feeds.title: Book Art Studios Blog
feeds.description: A book artist who lives in NZ with a passion for creating bespoke books and journals. Book Art Studios is a busy studio where adventures happen randomly. Liz writes about her books, her classes, her life in and outside of the studio. She likes to write about people she meets and experiences she has.

feeds.title: Christchurch City Council Blog
feeds.description: Christchurch City Council shares local information and interesting stuff. They are an access point to information, reading recommendations, local history, resources, and collections including eBooks, eAudiobooks, movies, music, magazines, comics, online courses, and encyclopedias.

feeds.title: The Spinoff
feeds.description: The Spinoff is an independent online magazine and full-service content agency. Since our foundation in 2014, our current affairs and cultural coverage have been embraced by an audience looking for a fresh perspective on New Zealand. We are a New Zealand site covering pop culture, politics and social life through features, criticism, interviews, videos and podcasts.

feeds.title: Gillian Candler Blog
feeds.description: I am an award winning writer (formerly an award winning publisher and teacher). I run writing workshops for children, visit schools and libraries to talk about writing and publishing, and participate in literary and children's festivals.

feeds.title: Time Out Bookstore Blog
feeds.description: The Time Out Bookstore blog features book reviews, author interviews, and updates on literary events, focusing on diverse and thought-provoking reads.

feeds.title: Cristina Sanders' Blog
feeds.description: Book reviews, colonial history. Jerningham Wakefield. Running. All here.

feeds.title: Aotearoa New Zealand Review of Books
feeds.description: The Aotearoa New Zealand Review of Books publishes long-form reviews of local fiction, nonfiction and poetry. We're a platform for in-depth discussions of contemporary literature, society and culture, featuring established and emerging reviewers from the South Pacific.

feeds.title: Scorpio Books Blog
feeds.description: Browse our collection of articles and book reviews.

feeds.title: Provo Library Children's Book Blog
feeds.description: The Provo Library Children's Book Blog is a great resource for parents and teachers looking for new and exciting books for children. The blog features reviews of new releases, as well as classic favorites. There are also posts on a variety of topics related to children's books, such as reading tips, author interviews, and book lists.

feeds.title: Sunshine Blog
feeds.description: Our posts discuss practical ways that teachers can implement a structured literacy approach to teaching in their classrooms.

feeds.title: Donna Goodacre Blog
feeds.description: Discover Donna Goodacre's captivating novels and the inspiration behind her storytelling. Explore her latest releases available from Amazon or Etsy.

feeds.title: Booklovers B&B Blog
feeds.description: Booklovers B&B is a boutique bed and breakfast in Mount Victoria, Wellington City - offering three generously sized rooms, each with an ensuite.

feeds.title: Auckland Libraries Blog
feeds.description: Auckland Libraries Blog shares book recommendations, library updates, and event news across Auckland's public libraries. It also highlights heritage stories, research tips, and digital learning resources.

feeds.title: Clearlingo Blog
feeds.description: As a professional, accredited, and qualified copy editor and proofreader, my goal is to ensure your writing is stress-free and polished. My approach is to listen to your needs and provide a cost-effective and suitable option, then work together with you to make sure the writing is clear, consistent and compelling while preserving your unique voice.

feeds.title: My Best Friends Are Books
feeds.description: Zac McCallum is a School Librarian at a primary school in Christchurch, New Zealand. He loves Children's and Young Adult literature. On his blog, he shares books that he is reading, books he wants to read, and any other book-related news. You will find news, reviews and interviews from the world of children's literature on his blog.

feeds.title: Woman Magazine NZ » Book
feeds.description: A digital platform for all kiwi women. WOMAN is about New Zealand women, for New Zealand women, by New Zealand women. WOMAN is relatable and real, with a proud Kiwi heart and soul. Kick back, relax and prepare to be inspired.

feeds.title: Book Blogger NZ Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Abbey Hartevelt. I live in the North Island of New Zealand. I love books so I thought why not write about some I've enjoyed. So this is a blog promoting some of the great books I've read. Hope you enjoy!

feeds.title: Enlighten Press Blog
feeds.description: Enlighten Press create an open learning forum with a shared reading experience. Their informative blog posts bring the best new ideas in positive psychology and education from a range of contributors, including our resident author. Learn more about wellbeing education, positive psychology and children with blog posts from our author.

feeds.title: The Bookish Guide To New Zealand Blog
feeds.description: I want to show you all the bookish spots that might not be on your average road-map and share some book recommendations with a focus on contemporary and historical fiction as well as middle grade and young adult fantasy-fiction.

feeds.title: Maureen Crisp Books
feeds.description: I've been writing for nearly twenty years for myself, for schools, and for publishers. I love learning about new things. I have written books about skeleton-stealing dogs, secret rock star lives, and invisible friends on Mars along with all sorts of other writing for the School Journal and magazines in New Zealand.

feeds.title: Philippa Werry's Blog
feeds.description: I am a New Zealand writer of fiction and non-fiction with a special interest in history. I belong to the Writers in Schools programme, talk at seminars and book evenings, run creative writing workshops, act as assessor and mentor and write a blog on Children's war books.

feeds.title: Nelson Public Libraries Blog
feeds.description: Nelson Public library service is one of the oldest in New Zealand, and indeed the library which has provided the longest continuous service to the public in New Zealand. Nelson Public Libraries connects people to local, national and global ideas and communities.

feeds.title: Kids' Blog
feeds.description: We post heaps of interesting stuff, like what's on for kids, great books, and gross facts. There is lots of other interesting stuff like reviews, cool internet links, and help with homework. We post new entries all the time; so keep checking back to find out what's changed.

feeds.title: Raven Books Blog
feeds.description: The Raven Books blog is a personal blog by Alissa Smith, a writer and book lover from New Zealand. The blog covers a wide range of topics related to books, reading, and writing, including Book reviews, Writing advice, Reading recommendations and more.

feeds.title: Wellington City Libraries Blog
feeds.description: As a team, Wellington City Libraries contributes to offering a quality reference service across the library system, where customers who need help accessing information in particular areas can contact someone who has knowledge of the resources in those areas. They are also responsible for assessing and responding to the information needs of the communities throughout the Wellington area.

feeds.title: Anne Ingram Blog
feeds.description: Nelson Public Libraries, offers book reviews, reading recommendations, and updates on library events and services.
